hypothesis.single_sentence: Training and evaluating G-ORS with the same deterministic unknown-depth representation will reduce the documented 2026 deployment shift without changing the frozen XGBoost decision system.
hypothesis.source_fact: The distributed README states that G-ORS is single-layer and its 2026 depth is entirely missing.

diagnostic_only_motivation.warning: These exposed outer-label diagnostics motivate the invariant transform but must not determine any parameter or imply independent validation.

exactly_one_change.name: gors_fold_symmetric_depth_mask
exactly_one_change.categorical_encoding_policy: preserve original fold-train codes for shared categories; candidate-only fallback=max(original)+1; validation-only=-1
exactly_one_change.arm_encoding_consequence: A G-ORS fallback is -1 when unseen in natural-depth fold-train; B G-ORS fallback is known because symmetric mask exposes it in fold-train

primary_comparator.model: frozen XGBoost refit with same fold, seed, parameters, and 700 trees

candidate.training: mask G-ORS depth inputs in fold-train
candidate.validation: mask G-ORS depth inputs in fold-validation
candidate.model: refit XGBoost with same fold, seed, parameters, and 700 trees

comparison.secondary_context: original frozen natural-depth OOF; never substitutes for comparator A
comparison.candidate_refits: same frozen folds, seeds, XGBoost parameters, exactly 700 trees, and exact per-fold postprocess

secondary_incumbent_safety_gate.role: veto-only incumbent safety gate; cannot replace or rescue a failed B-minus-A primary gate

known_support_caveat.interpretation: Q4 G-ORS F1 is undefined/non-informative; it cannot count as evidence for the G-group uplift gate.

one_shot_evaluation_after_separate_autho.deployment_diagnostic: Compare the candidate's G-ORS result with both the frozen natural-depth arm and the already-recorded frozen validation-only-mask stress; this diagnostic cannot override a failed primary gate.
one_shot_evaluation_after_separate_autho.stop_rule: Close this family after the single outer comparison; do not tune station, layer, columns, missing code, thresholds, or model settings from the result.
